Explore the Norway sessions in Charging history ↗
What went into these results?

Session data: Dataset 1 supplies reported energy, plug-in time, and unplug time. Dataset 2 supplies estimated charger power. Each plan knows the session's energy need and unplug deadline.

Price scenario: The original Norway sessions are mapped to the nearest matching weekday in the same month of 2025. Local plug-in clock time and elapsed connection duration are preserved in Chicago time.

Excluded sessions: 1,552 lack required inputs or prices; 41 need more energy than the estimated charger can deliver in the connection window. These sessions contribute no savings.

Available information: The live model was calibrated on the 90 days before 2025. Missing live readings use the simulator's fallback behavior. No future settled price enters SPARC's decisions.

Scope: Costs include hourly supply and the study's fixed delivery rates. Flat bill charges and capacity-charge dollars are excluded. Planners prefer avoiding capacity-risk hours. These are independent scenarios, not a simultaneous fleet or observed Norwegian electricity bills.

Full-study snapshot: This page always shows the verified full Dataset 1 comparison for 2025. Filters and what-if settings on Charging history do not change this table.

Source: Sørensen, Sartori, Lindberg and Andresen. Published dataset · Methodology.
